rooms.title: Games
rooms.lede: Connect four. I go second and I do not go easy.
body: The computer searches five moves ahead, so it will take a win the moment you leave one and block yours the move before you get it. Beating it is a real thing to have done.
Tab to a column and press enter if you would rather not use a mouse.
